manualReview.summary: Author ZT6 effects for 95% of tested genes agree with the registered output (effects only)
manualReview.note: The official raw-count matrix and SOFT match the SHA-256 values documented in the dataset README. The paper's headline 263 DEGs come from a limma moderated F-test pooling the four SD-versus-SS timepoints, which is not the registered ZT6 estimand. However, BMC Genomics Additional file 2 (12864_2020_7050_MOESM2_ESM.xlsx, SHA-256 2600a3b7..., sheet DEG) lists all 13,856 author-tested genes with separate per-timepoint SD-vs-SS effects. Its SDvsSS_6hr.FC column is the registered contrast in the same orientation. GEO lists 52 samples, matching the paper's 52 mice, with exactly 6 SS6hr and 6 SD6hr libraries at ZT6; these are the 12 registered libraries. The author fit uses all 52 samples with shared TMM normalization and limma variance moderation, while the registered edgeR-QL fit uses only the 12 ZT6 libraries. Author Ensembl IDs were joined exactly through the registered feature map (SHA-256 afa3efb8..., as recorded in provenance); 374 IDs without a current symbol and 15 IDs whose symbol is summed over several features were excluded, with no symbol renaming. Against the current registered DE table, the R 4.6.0 regeneration (SHA-256 5fb5171c...), 13,184 pairs (95.15% of 13,856 author rows; 99.27% of 13,281 registered rows) give Pearson 0.944669, Spearman 0.958157, direction agreement 95.00% (12,525/13,184), median absolute log2FC difference 0.014146 and paired RMS effect ratio 0.901098. All 258 paired author F-test DEGs agree in direction (Pearson 0.986937). The other 672 author rows (4.85%) are unpaired, so agreement covers 95% of the author-tested genes. Of those 672, 283 author genes have no registered row because the expression filters differ. The author FC column is read as a limma log2 coefficient. No author ZT6 P/FDR is reported, so inference is not assessed. Evidence and reproducible extraction are in continued-sources/GSE132308/turbo-2026-11-16-wave2/.
reviewFlags: Author ZT6 effects come from a whole-cohort limma fit over all 52 samples; the registered edgeR-QL fit uses only the 12 ZT6 libraries.
The only author FDR is a 4-timepoint moderated-F test; ZT6-specific author inference is not reported and is not assessed.
The author effect column is labelled FC; it is treated as a limma log2 coefficient (signed values, median absolute difference 0.014 from registered log2FC).

The registered feature map used for the Ensembl join (SHA-256 afa3efb8..., equal to provenance) is not in this checkout's pinned release; the comparison used a byte-identical copy, so it cannot be rerun from a clean checkout alone.

evidenceLinks.label: Author Additional file 2 (all tested genes, per-timepoint effects)

verificationReview.reason: 2026-11-16 full-table comparison against Additional file 2 sheet DEG column SDvsSS_6hr.FC (all 13,856 author-tested genes; same ZT6 SD-minus-SS contrast) and the current R 4.6.0 registered DE table (SHA-256 5fb5171c...). 13,184 finite matched effects (95.15% of author rows, 99.27% of registered rows); Pearson 0.944669, Spearman 0.958157, nonzero direction agreement 95.000% (12,525/13,184), median absolute log2FC difference 0.014146, paired RMS effect ratio 0.901098. The 12 registered ZT6 libraries are the author's ZT6 groups (GEO 52 samples = paper 52 mice). Exact Ensembl joins via the registered feature map. Author effects come from a 52-sample limma fit; the only author FDR is a 4-timepoint moderated-F test, so ZT6 inference is not assessed. Evidence and reproducible extraction are in continued-sources/GSE132308/turbo-2026-11-16-wave2/.
verificationReview.nextStep: Keep inference unassessed unless ZT6-specific author P/FDR becomes available. The 283 author genes outside the registered filter remain coverage gaps, not mismatches. A whole-cohort limma reconstruction could be added as a separate sensitivity analysis. Before an additional comparison spec is added, regenerate the derived author-effects.tsv to keep all 13,856 author rows (unpaired rows keyed by Ensembl ID) without the registered columns, and retain a checksummed copy of the feature map with the evidence.

comparabilityReview.basis: Registered edgeR-QL ZT6 sleep-deprivation output against the author per-timepoint ZT6 SD-vs-SS effect for every author-tested gene; author inference is not ZT6-specific and is not compared.
comparabilityReview.reference: BMC Genomics 2020 (PMC7491139) Additional file 2, 12864_2020_7050_MOESM2_ESM.xlsx sheet DEG, column SDvsSS_6hr.FC (13,856 genes), retrieved and hashed on 2026-11-16.

cohort.note: GEO lists 52 samples, matching the paper's 52 mice; ZT6 has exactly 6 SS6hr and 6 SD6hr libraries, the 12 registered libraries. The author effect is estimated in a fit over all 52 samples (shared normalization and variance), so the estimator differs although the ZT6 animals are the same.

contrast.note: Sleep deprivation minus spontaneous sleep at 6 h after lights-on in both; orientation agrees (Hspa8 +0.444 author, +0.455 registered).

features.note: Exact author Ensembl IDs joined through the registered feature map; 374 IDs without a current symbol and 15 IDs in symbols summed over several features are excluded unresolved. 283 author genes lie outside the registered expression filter.

effects.note: 13,184 pairs: Pearson 0.944669, Spearman 0.958157, direction agreement 95.00%, median absolute log2FC difference 0.014146, RMS ratio 0.901098. The author column is labelled FC and read as a limma log2 coefficient.

inference.note: Authors report only a 4-timepoint moderated-F FDR; no ZT6 P/FDR exists. Missing author ZT6 inference is unassessed, not a mismatch.

coverage.note: The author table is the full 13,856-gene tested universe; 13,184 pairs cover 95.15% of author rows and 99.27% of registered rows (the author-concordance-v2 coverage gate uses registered coverage).

comparabilityReview.criteria: author-concordance-v2 on exact Ensembl joins with finite effects: at least 30 pairs, at least 90% coverage, Pearson and Spearman at least 0.90 or direction agreement at least 90%. No threshold, exclusion or mapping tuning; inference is not compared.
comparabilityReview.conclusion: Author ZT6 effects for 95% of tested genes (13,184 of 13,856) agree with the registered output by correlation and direction (effects only). ZT6 inference and the whole-cohort versus ZT6-only estimator difference remain unassessed.

appliedCorrections: Correction 1 (author-side coverage): not applied to evidence files, because this step may edit only the corrected entry and the evidence README. The proposed additionalComparisonSpec is therefore withheld (null) instead of emitted on the paired-only author-effects.tsv, which would make the builder report 100% author coverage. The README now documents the paired-only content and the required regeneration (all 13,856 author rows, unpaired rows keyed by Ensembl ID, new SHA-256 in SOURCES.tsv); manualReview, verificationReview and comparabilityReview state the 95.15% author denominator.

Correction 2 (registered columns in author reference): README now states that author-effects.tsv carries diagnostic registered_logFC/registered_padj columns and is a joined working table; the spec that would have pinned it as the author source is withheld, and verificationReview.nextStep asks for regeneration without those columns.

Correction 3 (R 4.6.0 statement): manualReview.note, verificationReview.reason and the README now say the figures were computed on the R 4.6.0 regeneration (SHA-256 5fb5171c...). No spec note is emitted, so the builder's automatic R 4.4.1 suffix cannot appear.

Correction 4 (feature map provenance): README records the provenance-pinned GSE132308_feature_map.tsv.gz with full SHA-256 afa3efb845e0fd7385f8d79dcd987f6c5d82af1146f9242424759f29a2de85d1, taken from a local worktree, and states that no copy is kept in the evidence folder so the script cannot be rerun from a clean checkout; a reviewFlag records the same limitation. Retaining a checksummed copy was not done (outside this step's allowed edits).

Correction 5 (wording): manualReview.summary changed to 'Author ZT6 effects for 95% of tested genes agree with the registered output (effects only)'; manualReview.note and comparabilityReview.conclusion/coverage note now state the 95% author denominator.
notes: Verdict upheld_with_corrections; statuses kept as proposed (validated_with_notes/direct, available/method_differences, limited with not_tested inference), no upgrade. additionalComparisonSpec is null (ledger unchanged for specs) until author-effects.tsv is regenerated with all 13,856 author rows and no registered columns; once that is done the proposed spec can be emitted with the new sha256 and a note sentence saying the figures were computed on the R 4.6.0 output (5fb5171c...).
